newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fairyoung mulls port operations spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Fairyoung mulls port operations spinoff.

text.p: Fairyoung Holdings Ltd was considering listing its port operations on a reputable stock exchange such as Hong Kong when capital market conditions are suitable, the company said in a statement published on Monday.

"Recovery of the China economy is expected to be beneficial to the group's investment portfolio in China, especially the port operations and the sales of its property interests," the property investment and securities trading concern said.
In May, Fairyoung said it was planning a restructuring that would involve a possible spin off of its China port and related businesses on the Hong Kong stock exchange.
The company earlier said it posted a 93 percent drop in its interim earnings to HK$2.37 million for the first half of 1996.
Its shares were untraded at HK$3.025 in early Monday morning.
